name: Gritz N Wafflez
facts: Gritz N Wafflez is a woman-owned Texas Flava, Southern Hospitality spot at 3183 Wilshire Blvd, Suite 185, Los Angeles, CA 90010 (Koreatown).
Open daily, 9 AM – 3 PM.
First 15 minutes of valet are complimentary.
GNW Karaoke is every Wednesday, 6 – 10 PM.
Order Up! is a free game: play as often as you like with no account needed.
A free member account (name, phone, email) is needed only to save a score or claim a prize.
One free member account per person and per phone.
Order Up! levels last 90 seconds each; 3 walk-outs close the kitchen.
Pick Kid mode (12 & under) or Adult mode before you play; each has its own prizes, best score and weekly board.
Kid mode needs a parent or guardian (18+) to sign in first.
The weekly board resets every Monday; top score by Sunday close wins the weekly prize.
Weekly prize: Free Wingz N' Wafflez + a karaoke shoutout, crowned at GNW Karaoke Wednesday.
Adult prizes: 13,500 Kiki Palmer; 22,000 Smackin' Mac; 32,000 Fried Cheese Gritz; 46,500 Original Collard Green Dip.
Kid prizes: 9,500 OJ; 11,000 French Friez; 12,750 Sweet Gritz; 13,250 Chocolate Chip Waffle.
Game prizes must be used within 3 days; one prize at a time per member.
Daily Spin: one free spin per member per day, every slice wins something.
Rewards ladder: 250 / 450 / 700 / 1,100 points.

Menu prices are on the online order page.
Antidote's poster on the wall in the game gives +250 once per run.

It's our free game. You run the line at Gritz N Wafflez: build each guest's plate, serve it and deliver it to the right table, fast.

qa.q: How do I play Order Up!?
qa.a: Tap food tiles to build the plate, tap 🛎️ Serve, then tap the hot plate on the pass and tap the guest's table.

qa.q: How do I build a plate?
qa.a: Tap the food tiles to put them on the plate. Tap a tile again or tap ↩️ Undo to take one off.

qa.q: How do I deliver a plate?
qa.a: Tap the plate on the pass, then tap the guest's table. A server or Jurni walks it out.

qa.q: What if I deliver to the wrong table?
qa.a: The plate comes back colder and you lose points (−15).
Plates cool on the pass: hot, warm, cooling, cold. Cold food pays less and gets no tip, so serve fast.

qa.q: How many plates can wait on the pass?
qa.a: Up to 4 plates.
You earn for speed (up to +190, counted to 0.1 s), heat (up to +80), the order's pay ($ × 4), tips ($ × 10), +30 per correct item and +40 for a clean build with no undo.
Speed points drop every 0.1 second from the moment a table sits down, so the faster you serve, the more you get.

qa.q: How do I get the big tip?
qa.a: Serve a perfect plate (no undo), hot, to the right table. Cold plates get no tip.
Perfect, fast plates in a row build a multiplier from ×1.2 up to ×2. A wrong plate resets it.
Serve every plate at a table within 10 seconds of each other for +30 per guest.

qa.q: What do I get for clearing a level?
qa.a: 150 × the level, plus 75 for every walk-out you avoided (+225 and up).
Wrong plate −20, adding a NO item −60, wrong table −15, undercooked −30, charred −15, and a walk-out −50.
A table that waited too long and left. Three walk-outs close the kitchen and end your run.
90 seconds. Pass a level with fewer than 3 tables walking out.
Levels 1–3: just tap and serve. Level 4: a cook leaves, so you're on the fryer. Level 5: the whole kitchen, with waffle irons and the skillet too.

qa.q: How do I use the fryer?
qa.a: At level 4, tap the tile for catfish, wingz, tenderz or shrimp, then tap the basket on ✨ perfect. It lands on your plate.

qa.q: How do the waffle irons and skillet work?
qa.a: At level 5, pour into the waffle irons and open them on 🟢. The skillet does eggs, bacon and sautéed shrimp.
Each fried, pressed or skillet item gives up to +55 for perfect. Golden or a little brown gives less, and burnt gives almost nothing.
At level 5, tickets can ask for things like sautéed shrimp, sunny-side eggs, extra-crispy bacon or syrup on the side. Tap the matching tile. 'Extra hot' must arrive hot.

qa.q: How do I read the tickets?
qa.a: Tickets show the table number, dish, items, extras and NO leave-offs. The reddest ticket is the most impatient table.

qa.q: How often can I play Order Up!?
qa.a: As often as you like. It's free with no account needed.
No. Order Up! is free to play right now.

qa.q: Is Order Up! a game of skill?
qa.a: Yes. Your score depends only on how well you run the line, and no prize is awarded by chance.

qa.q: Do I have to buy anything to play or win?
qa.a: No. No purchase is necessary to play, spin, or win, and buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: What are Kid mode and Adult mode?
qa.a: Pick one before you play. Kid mode (12 & under) has slower timers and kid-sized prizes. Adult mode is regular speed with the bigger prizes.
A parent or guardian (18+) signs in first, then hands over the phone. Timers are gentler and cooking only starts at level 5 (fryer, slower).

qa.q: Does my child need an account?
qa.a: No. The parent or guardian signs in with their own name, phone and email. The child never enters any information.

qa.q: How do I leave Kid mode?
qa.a: The app asks for the last 4 digits of the parent's phone number.

qa.q: Where do kid scores and prizes go?
qa.a: Kid play, best score and kid prizes are saved on the parent's account.

qa.q: What can I win in Adult mode?
qa.a: 13,500 = Free Kiki Palmer; 22,000 = Free side of Smackin' Mac; 32,000 = Free Fried Cheese Gritz; 46,500 = Free Original Collard Green Dip.
9,500 = Free Fresh Squeezed OJ; 11,000 = Free side of French Friez; 12,750 = Free Sweet Gritz; 13,250 = Free Chocolate Chip Waffle.
